usageNotes: Deletes a named IPSet from an LXC container's firewall configuration. By default the request fails if the IPSet still contains members — pass `force: true` to delete all member entries and the set in one operation. Requires `VM.Config.Network` privilege on the container's VM path, and the container must exist on the specified node (it does not need to be running).

examples.summary: Force-delete an IPSet named 'trusted-mgmt' (including all its member IPs) from LXC 201 on node pve1

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named IPSet and, if `force` is used, all of its member IP/CIDR entries from the container's firewall; any firewall rules referencing this IPSet by name will become dangling references and may silently stop matching traffic.
tips: List existing IPSets first with the corresponding GET operation to confirm the name and membership before deleting.
If the IPSet is referenced by active firewall rules, remove or update those rules before deleting the set to avoid silent rule breakage.
Omitting `force` on a non-empty IPSet returns an error — use it intentionally when you want a single atomic delete of set + members.
